question: In which of the following years was the Mughal empire established by Babur?
solution:
The correct answer is **__1526__.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Babur** founded the Mughal Dynasty in the **16th century** by conquering** Northern India from Kabul** as his base.
 
• Babur was a warrior chieftain from which is now known as Uzbekistan, who defeated** Ibrahim Lodhi, the Sultan of Delhi **in the** first battle of Panipat**.
 
• Babur ruled for 4 years; **1526-1530**.
 
• Mughal Dynasty ruled till **1720**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
